changes: Implemented formal Layer 2 Engineering unlock path: formal evaluator rebuilds Engineering suite from final-report evidence, validates host-bound Claude/Codex review artifacts, binds receipt evidence digest, rejects forged suite summaries, and keeps Authority/production/full-unattended claims false.
usage: Run npm --prefix packages/main run build, npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke, then lattice baseline_suite_report --layer=engineering and lattice capability_claim_formal_evaluate --target=engineering --format=json against formal artifacts.
expectedOutcome: Formal Engineering proof unlocks only the Layer 2 Engineering claim when all formal final reports and bindings are valid; forged, stale, local-only, missing or mismatched evidence remains locked or blocked.
actualTranscript: build PASS; lattice-baseline-smoke PASS; process-fact-contract PASS; command-ownership-contract PASS; reviewer-readonly-command-policy-smoke PASS; lifecycle-registry-contract PASS; lattice validate --story=B-ce79 --json allPass=true with 24/24 verification intents covered; Claude concept PASS; Codex quality PASS; Claude test-coverage PASS; delivery reviewer PASS.
outcomeDiff: No difference observed: actual behavior matches expected Layer 2-only unlock and higher-layer/Authority lock boundaries.
limitations: Layer 2 Engineering Baseline claim can be formally unlocked; Loop Engineering, Production Safety, Capability Claim, Authority receipt verification, production DONE and full unattended authority remain intentionally locked until their own baselines pass.
pitfalls: Initial implementation trusted suite summaries and prefix-only review refs; REVIEW caught both high issues. Fix was limited to real correctness issues: revalidate from final-report artifacts and require host-bound review JSON plus evidence digest receipts.
